# GKR Challenge Trace canonical test vector

This vector is generated by the synthetic public FCONN fixture in
`main_range_tests.cpp::testFconnTwoPointAuthentication`.  It contains no
private model weights, private input, witness dump, or secret randomness.

## Encoding rules

- GKR Transcript domain: `zkGPT-proof-v2-chain-sha256`.
- Logical Transcript instance: `gkr-main`.
- Every absorbed item is encoded as:

  ```text
  le64(label_length) || label || le64(payload_length) || payload
  ```

- Integers use unsigned 64-bit little-endian payloads.
- `Fr` and `G1` use the canonical MCL BN254 serialization already used by the
  production Transcript.
- Observer state digests use:

  ```text
  SHA256("zkGPT-transcript-observer-state-v1" || raw_transcript_state)
  ```

  This diagnostic digest is read-only and is not absorbed into the protocol.

## Canonical GKR Proof v3 digest

The SHA-256 digest of the exact 5,380 canonical bytes returned by
`serializeGKRProof` for this public four-FCONN fixture is:

```text
d237039f950017bdd524f34f412690d9672a018ddc04585507400a7020f97707
```

This is a SHA-256 digest of serialized proof bytes. It is not the GKR final
Transcript binding field and not a Fiat-Shamir challenge.

The values above are asserted directly by the Release test; this file is not
used as an input that could silently update the expected results.
